ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; the fluke surface is composed of high-density low-intensity pixels (black), with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to <1% of the surface area at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black pigmentation across the entire surface; distinct high-contrast white clusters at (x_left_tip, y_left_tip) and (x_right_tip, y_right_tip); subtle low-contrast circular grey-scale variations in the lower-central region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression; acute angle calculated at approximately 40-50 degrees with a high depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency serrations across the left lobe; right lobe trailing edge exhibits higher-amplitude variations and a significant terminal jaggedness near the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature along the leading edges, tapering to narrow, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; faint circular impressions visible as darker rings on the black field in the mid-lobal regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible barnacle colonization (high-intensity white clusters) at both distal tips; irregular tissue protrusion visible on the extreme right trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly uniform solid-black pigmentation across the entire ventral fluke surface with minimal mottling.
